subject: BUG-261: ProgressManager.HOUSES omits 'ai', a house 87 live files record progress against
description: Found 2026-09-05 by Nancy during the BUG-255 vote. ProgressManager.HOUSES is the canonical house registry and contains web, shield, forge, script, cloud, code, key, eye, dark-arts, matrix, divergent. It does NOT contain 'ai'. Meanwhile 87 files under _app/houses/ai/ call ModuleProgress.complete('ai', ...) in production today, and ContentCatalog carries house:'ai' entries. So the registry that other code treats as authoritative is missing a house the platform actively uses. CONSEQUENCE ALREADY REALISED, and it is mine: my BUG-254 fix replaced awardHouseMastery's hand-written VALID_HOUSES (which DID contain 'ai') with a derivation from HOUSES, so 'ai' silently lost mastery eligibility. Impact is LATENT rather than live, because awardHouseMastery is only reached when pathModules.length > 0 and 'ai' has no LearningPaths entry either, so mastery was already unreachable for it. That is luck, not design: I removed an entry from an allow-list without checking what used it, and a second gate happened to be shut. The lesson is the deriving was right and the SOURCE was not audited: derive-from-authoritative is only safe when the authoritative thing is actually complete. BLOCKS OPTION A OF BUG-255: allow-listing houses against HOUSES would silently stop recording XP for an entire house on day one, which is worse than the exploit it fixes. Nancy verified the same shape for ContentCatalog and option B, where live module ids like ai13-01-agent-patterns, cx-dl-09 and cx-cap-10 have zero catalog entries. FIX NEEDS A DECISION, not a patch: is 'ai' a real house that belongs in HOUSES (with an icon, colour, domain, and a LearningPaths entry), or is it a content namespace that should never have been passed as a houseId? Those lead to opposite edits. Do not patch HOUSES until BUG-255 resolves, because C may change what the registry has to be.
